notes: Idatsy (IDATSY) is a fixed-supply OpenZeppelin ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints 1,000,000,000 tokens (1e27 minor units) once to msg.sender, the factory. There is no mint, burn, fee, pause, owner or upgrade function, so launch flows move exactly the amounts transferred. No application contracts are deployed.
